name: Ao-chan Can't Study!
description: Ao Horie's father, a popular erotic fiction author, chose Ao's name because A stands for “apple” and O stands for “orgy”! Desperate to escape her father's legacy and get into a prestigious university, Ao devotes herself to studying instead of pursuing romance. She has no time for boys, but there's just one problem: Kijima, her handsome and popular classmate, just confessed his love to her! And to make matters worse, she can't stop thinking dirty thoughts about him! Looks like escaping her father's influence will be harder than she thought...

videos.title: Ao-chan Can't Enjoy Her Youth
videos.overview: Ao-chan isn't interested in romance or boys — which is ironic, because a certain handsome classmates of hers is very interested in Ao-chan.

videos.title: Ao-chan Can't Easily Decline
videos.overview: Ao-chan overhears a distressing rumor about Kijima's, um... talent? Assets? Euphemisms are hard and Ao-chan is in quite a predicament, that’s for sure...

videos.title: Ao-chan Can't Protect Her Lower Half
videos.overview: When an oblivious Ao-chan suffers from a wardrobe malfunction, it's up to Kijima to save the day… except he has no idea how to fix it without looking like a total perv!

videos.title: Miyabi-chan Can't Be Beaten
videos.overview: Ao-chan receives a disturbing photograph of Kijima in a compromising position! Is this all a big misunderstanding, or is Kijima just as depraved as she suspects?

videos.title: Ao-chan Can't Lead Virgins
videos.overview: Kijima's startling confession gives Ao-chan quite a shock... and the upper hand over Kijima, too. Mwa-ha-ha!

videos.title: Kijima-kun Can't Wait Any Longer
videos.overview: With a deadline looming, Ao-chan joins her father's editor on a research mission at... a "Love!Meat" festival? Just what kind of research is Ao supposed to be doing?!

videos.title: Ao-chan Can Handle the Beach
videos.overview: Ao-chan WILL improve her grades, and to prove her dedication, she arrives three hours early for a study group near the beach. Three guesses who she unexpectedly runs into.

videos.title: Kijima-kun Lacks Stamina
videos.overview: Ao-chan thinks she knows exactly what's wrong with Kijima, and she's concocted a clever plan to remedy the situation. But then her dad decides to lend a helping hand...

videos.title: Ao-chan Needs More Than Fantasies
videos.overview: Ao-chan feels weird after ending things with Kijima, but it was the right thing to do. She needs to study! ...but if studying is right for her, why can't she focus?!

videos.title: Dad Can't Offer Support
videos.overview: Ao-chan wants to participate in her school's sports festival... and so does her father. But with Kijima cheering from the sidelines, Ao can't risk her dad messing things up!

videos.title: Ao-chan Can't Wear Silky Panties
videos.overview: Ao-chan has a package delivered. That is not a double entendre. She literally orders something off the internet and a panic spiral ensues.

videos.title: Ao-chan Can't Study
videos.overview: Ao-chan knows how take her relationship with Kijima to the next level... but it would mean breaking a promise she made to Kijima.
